svg.text: STAGE 445 🎉 · TOPIC 85 🎉 · P883 / P884 · SVG 89 · 448 DIMS
Enterprise SIP RFC 5626 Outbound Dual-Edge Flow-Token & RFC 5923 mTLS Connection Reuse Guard
企业 SIP RFC 5626 Outbound [2,4] 双活边缘流、HMAC Flow-Token 防劫持与 RFC 5923 mTLS SAN 防串租户门禁（🎉 Stage 445 与第 85 大专题双里程碑）
1. Outbound HMAC Flow-Token & Dual-Edge Gate (P883)
• 痛点：Path Flow-Token 明文编码 IP 被篡改反射，或单连接 SBC 重启失联
• 双活门禁：强制 HMAC-SHA256 令牌验签并为每个 +sip.instance 维持 [2, 4] 条流
❌ SPOF/Hijack: Forged Base64 Flow-Token | Single reg-id=1 edge connection
✅ P883 Gate: HMAC-SHA256 Flow-Token (SIP 430) + [2, 4] Redundant Edge Flows
Action: verify_hmac_sha256_flow_token_and_enforce_dual_reg_id_flows
确定性收敛指标（P883）：
✔ clampedHijackedFlowTokensOrDroppedEdgeCalls = 0（0 令牌劫持或单点漏话）
✔ clampedActiveOutboundEdgeFlowsPerInstance ∈ [2, 4]（跨可用区双活边缘流）
2. CRLF Keepalive & RFC 5923 mTLS SAN Gate (P884)
• 痛点：NAT 老化死流无感知，或未验证 mTLS SAN 即允许 Via ;alias 跨租户复用
• 证书钉扎：将 CRLF 保活锁在 [25, 120]s 并强制 SAN === Via 域名 1:1 匹配
❌ Spoof/Zombie: Unverified Via ;alias hijacks 6 sockets | 600s stale timer
✅ P884 Gate: mTLS SAN===Via Match + [25, 120]s Double-CRLF Ping/Pong
Action: require_mtls_san_match_for_alias_reuse_and_clamp_crlf_keepalive
确定性收敛指标（P884）：
✔ clampedCrossTenantReusedSocketsOrZombieFlows = 0（0 跨租户串流或死连接）
✔ clampedCrlfKeepaliveIntervalSeconds ∈ [25, 120] s（双回车极简保活周期）
3. Quantitative Evaluation Matrix & Production Verification Checklist (Stage 445 🎉 · Topic 85 🎉 · 448 Dims · 893 Guards · 887 Tests)
• Guardrail P883: evaluateSipRfc5626OutboundFlowTokenHmacBindingAndDualEdgeRegIdFailoverGate => 0 token hijacks | [2, 4] flows
• Guardrail P884: evaluateSipRfc5626Rfc5923CrlfKeepalivePongTimeoutAndMtlsSanConnectionReuseGate => 0 alias hijacks | [25, 120]s CRLF
